create_balanced_batch_sampler: create a BalancedBatchSampler to distribute atom-balanced batches across replicas in distributed training
build_stateful_distributed_sampler: build a StatefulDistributedSampler that resumes data sampling from a specific training iteration and epoch
run_balanced_partition: run the balanced_partition function to greedily partition items into equal-sum groups using a heap
test_ocp_collater: test the deprecated OCPCollater class to collate a list of AtomicData objects into a single batch
review_ensure_supported: review the ensure_supported function to validate a dataset has natoms metadata for balanced sampling
